description: Start (or reuse) a live session and return a studio URL for the user. While it runs, every texel_render result appears in their open browser tab immediately, so they can watch the skin evolve and give feedback mid-way. Call it before the first render and share the URL with the user.

open.description: Also open the URL in the default browser of the machine running this server.

port.description: Preferred local port (default 4747; the next free one is used if busy).

name: texel_live
title: Start live preview
